3. By means of this writ petition, petitioner has sought the following relief:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mamdamus commanding and directing the respondents to shift the petitioner from Sitarganj Jail, District Udham Singh Nagar to District Jail Phursadi, District Chamoli."
4.

entities.text: Sitarganj Jail, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is not in dispute that petitioner was convicted vide judgment and order dated 28.09.2022,
passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO), Rudraprayag for offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 342, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences, Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences, Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Petitioner has challenged his conviction and sentence in an appeal which is pending before this Court.
5. During trial, petitioner was lodged in District Jail Chamoli Pursari.
Upon his conviction, he has been shifted to Central Jail Sitarganj.
In this writ petition, petitioner has sought a direction to the authorities to transfer him from Central Jail Sitarganj to District Jail Chamoli Pursari.
6. State Counsel was asked to get instructions.
On instructions, he submits that District Jail Chamoli Pursari do not have sufficient space and only under trials are kept there who are shifted to other jails upon their conviction, if convicted.
He further submits that District Jail Chamoli Pursari accommodates prisoners from District Rudraprayag and Chamoli, therefore, it is facing problem of overcrowding.
Thus, he submits that it is not possible to transfer petitioner from Central Jail Sitarganj to District Jail Chamoli Pursari.

1 7.
We find substance in the submission made by learned State Counsel.
Since the District Jail Chamoli Pursari is already overcrowded, therefore, no direction can be passed to transfer petitioner from Central Jail Sitarganj to District Jail Chamoli Pursari.
8. There is no scope for interference in this writ petition.
Accordingly, writ petition fails and is hereby dismissed.
No order as to costs.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 13.08.2024 AK WPCRL/792/2024 on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108435993/
